    Evaluated projectives (Lemma 6.3) #

    "The projectives are included with their regular gradings. […] Projective summands contribute zero." At a projective label p, the evaluated module M_p = R⁰_{F p} is the cyclic graded projective e_p A₀ generated in degree 0 by 1_p (Yoneda: colAlg, colAlg_smul_unit), so all its higher Ext groups vanish (extVanish_proj).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
